title: The invisible weakness in a feeder link
story: An emulated satellite feeder link carries unencrypted test traffic without link-layer protection during an operational audit.
human_decisions: Commander proactively evacuates traffic from unencrypted link despite zero active packet loss.
Commander approves PB-06 failover to domestic encrypted gateway.

objective.what: Coastal tower CHN-05 shifts traffic away from unprotected satellite feeder link to verified protected domestic path.

schedule.what: Judge injects synthetic audit inspecting feeder link security controls.
Satellite operator discovers test feeder link operating without link-layer encryption.
M1 monitors link throughput and confirms zero packet loss on active stream.
M3 evaluates link indicators and abstains from threat classification.
Gap Analyst audits mandatory NTN link-layer encryption standards.
Gap Analyst audits satellite cyber baseline rules.
Commander orders proactive traffic avoidance away from the unprotected feeder link.
Mobile operator tests protected domestic backup path.
Commander approves PB-06 failover to protected domestic gateway.
M1 confirms all operational traffic successfully rerouted onto protected domestic path.
